_note: Demo FAQ facts the assistant may quote. Nothing else about refunds or returns may be promised.
label: After a return is approved, a free return label is emailed within 10 minutes.
refund: The replacement or refund follows once the courier collects the item. Refunds reach the original payment method within 5 to 7 working days.
replacement: After approval the customer chooses a replacement or a refund. A replacement depends on stock.
other_returns: Returns that are not about damage or a fault (changed mind, wrong size, colour) are started from the Returns page in the customer's account, within the item's return window. This chat only handles damaged or faulty deliveries.
human: A colleague reviews the case and replies by email within one working day.
